messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> metering-ingest-token-lag (P1). PagerDuty ID PD-8421. Trigger: consumer group lag spike for topic 'usage-ingest' > 1M messages.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-8421 assigned to mike (oncall). Rule: auto-escalate in 5m if not acknowledged.

mike (oncall): acked via PD. I'm on it — standing up investigation. tagging @nina and @leo.

leo (sre): seeing a flood of lag metrics in grafana: 
- consumer_lag_total (usage-ingest, metering-ingest-cg) jumped from ~8k to ~1.2M at 03:12 UTC
- write_ahead_queue length increasing on ingest-proxy pods

nina (eng): checking consumer state. running:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/metering-ingest -c consumer | tail -n 200
# observed repeated error: Timeout while fetching from broker, then RebalanceInProgress
```

nina (eng): also ran offset check: 
```
./tools/kafka_offsets.sh --group metering-ingest-cg --topic usage-ingest
# output: 1203456 lag across 12 partitions, leader broker 10.2.5.12
```

sam (billing): if this stays stalled we risk undercounting tokens for billing windows closing at 04:00 UTC. We might need to hold invoice runs or flag potential delta. Tagging support to prepare customer comms.

jordan (support): prepping templated note. Do we have an ETA? I can hold off public notes until we confirm undercount vs delay.

mike (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) restart consumer deployment to force rebalance (low risk) 2) if lag persists, scale consumers x2 and temporarily enable backfill mode downstream 3) if token counts lost, trigger ingest-reprocess job from kafka offsets snapshot. Executing step 1 now.

leo (sre): restarting one replica to test. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metering-ingest -n prod`

incident-bot: Action logged: restart triggered by mike (oncall).

nina (eng): restart succeeded on pod metering-ingest-5f4b7. Logs show consumer group rebalanced but still seeing `CommitFailedException` intermittently. Looking at broker metrics — network egress on broker-12 spiking.

leo (sre): pinging infra team on broker-12 (possible network flapping). `@infra` bump.

infra (message via webhook): investigating broker-12 NIC; IOPS spike from backup job coinciding with lag. Rolling ephemeral maintenance to move leader replicas off broker-12.

mike (oncall): good. we should avoid scaling until leader movement completes because moving partitions while scaling made earlier issues worse.

nina (eng): after partitions moved, consumer lag started to shrink (seen in metrics). Current lag: ~250k and decreasing.

sam (billing): can we estimate token delta if this had caused dropped messages? how many unprocessed messages map to billing tokens?

nina (eng): rough calc: avg tokens per message ~ 6. Current unprocessed ~250k -> ~1.5M tokens. That's ~0.02% of daily token volume but could impact a few small invoices. We'll produce exact reconciliation numbers after backfill.

jordan (support): drafting proactive note for affected customers: short delay in usage reporting; no money lost expected but final invoices may move. Will hold until we confirm. :memo:

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8421: ack recorded by mike (oncall) at 3161616175. Escalation timer cancelled.

leo (sre): after leader shuffle and consumer restarts we've seen steady downward slope for last 6 minutes. Starting a controlled scale to 6 replicas to catch up faster. Monitoring consumer commit rate.

nina (eng): triggering ingest-backfill-run with offsets snapshot at 3161616300 to reprocess any messages that might have been skipped. Command: 
```
./jobs/run_backfill.sh --snapshot 3161616300 --topic usage-ingest --consumer-group metering-ingest-cg
```

sam (billing): please flag any invoices that have finalization windows between 03:00-05:00 UTC; finance should hold capture until reconciliation confirms counts.

mike (oncall): noted. jordan, coordinate with finance if needed.

jordan (support): on it. I'm also posting an internal slack update to #customers-ready once we have a reconciliation estimate.

leo (sre): commit rate back to normal range, lag down to ~30k. Backfill job estimated time to complete: ~14m.

nina (eng): backfill completed at 3161616740. Reconciled tokens: +1,542,210 tokens applied to metering pipeline. No evidence of permanent message loss — all messages replayed.

sam (billing): that reconciles the estimate earlier — good. Finance: we no longer need to hold invoices; undercount fixed. I'll run a quick reconcile to verify invoice amounts.

mike (oncall): closing PD incident. Thanks everyone. Postmortem next steps: 1) add broker NIC saturation alert linked to metering-ingest P1 2) add consumer-group healthcheck with automated leader shuffle suggestion 3) run tabletop for invoice risk process.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8421 -> resolved by mike (oncall) at 3161616795.

jordan (support): internal note sent to #customers-ready: "Usage ingestion lag briefly affected reporting; backfill completed; invoices unaffected." :white_check_mark:

sam (billing): confirming with finance: no invoice adjustments required. Closing finance action.

mike (oncall): marking this thread resolved. Filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-2147 (broker network saturation mitigations). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
